name: SectionIcons
prompt: Premium commercial game UI concept for an original modern Korean urban life simulation called Ian Growing. Modern dense pixel art, tired ordinary protagonist, dry humor about work, education, debt, investing. Practical civic design, charcoal ink, muted blue-grey, warm uncoated paper, desaturated jade and selective oxblood seal. Group related data, stepped pixel edges, aligned numerals, restrained ink rules, explicit focus states, readable Korean. Show one finished straight-on game frame. No logos, generic mobile decoration, excessive frames, fantasy or web dashboard. Produce exactly one asset atlas, 3 columns x 2 rows, six evenly sized cells. Each contains a SINGLE chunky readable two-color 16 to 32 pixel inventory-style icon on one completely flat pale cream background. No frames, typography, characters, letters, text or grid lines. Top row left to right: an open diary with copper bookmark for life; a canvas backpack with buckle for items; an open folding wallet with bank note for finance. Bottom row left to right: a metal gear for settings; a little hand-stamped certificate with rosette for achievements; a school satchel with textbook for education. Strong orthographic silhouettes, solid ink with jade accent, industrial Korean urban stationery.
